prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin across all change types, as only one test has been completed so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- sign_in, reorder: -5.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] photo_upload_guidelines_flow: Add an instructional photo guidance screen prior to photo uploading with visual formatting recommendations. (why: 3 support tickets cited custom pet generation failures or bad visual output during pet generation.)
1: [choose_path, reorder] choose_path_after_story_reorder: Introduce a friendly welcome intro screen before story to set context before asking users to select a path. (why: choose_path drops 23.8% of users with a high mean time of 514s, indicating initial friction early in setup.)
2: [home, wait_info] waiting_screen_desktop_display_tip: Add progress indicators and tray navigation hints to the waiting screen while desktop rendering initializes. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not opening or displaying on desktop, and home median time is 201s.)
3: [adoption, hint] pick_friend_selection_hint: Display explicit reassurance hints on pet selection indicating pets can be customized or changed later. (why: Adoption conversion is only 60.9% and median selection time is 89s due to decision hesitation.)
4: [choose_path, layout] choose_path_split_layout: Change choose_path layout to split layout to compare pre-made vs custom pet options side-by-side. (why: choose_path mean duration is 514s; side-by-side visual comparison speeds up path selection.)
5: [finish, notification] home_intro_desktop_shortcut_notification: Add an explicit status text box on home intro confirming the pet companion background service is running. (why: Finish completion is 64.8% with an average time of 5815s, suggesting users idle without realizing setup finished.)
6: [sign_in, layout] sign_in_compact_layout: Switch sign-in screen to a compact layout with high-contrast call-to-action buttons. (why: 27.1% of users drop at sign-in with a 567s mean duration; simplifying layout reduces sign-in friction.)
